findings.current: A few months ago, while I was in Sichuan, the Slaughter Saint had casually mentioned him. He was one of the few things known about the Saint’s past, a past otherwise shrouded in mystery.
findings.defect: The draft makes the old man the subject of the Slaughter Saint’s earlier disclosure; the disclosed information was about Salcheonmun.
findings.rationale: The realization leads directly to Jin naming 살천문; the source does not say the Slaughter Saint mentioned this old man.
findings.replacement: A few months ago, while I was in Sichuan, the Slaughter Saint had mentioned Salcheonmun in passing. It was one of the few things he’d revealed about his otherwise shrouded past.
findings.source: 몇 달 전 사천에 머무를 당시 살성이 지나가듯 언급했던, 모든 것이 베일에 싸여 있는 그의 과거에서 유일하게 드러난 몇 안 되는 정보였으니까.

findings.current: Judging by that, it definitely wasn’t some Salcheonmun class reunion.
findings.defect: The specific twelfth cohort is omitted from the reunion joke.
findings.rationale: 12기 specifies the cohort, adding a deliberately mundane detail to the joke.
findings.replacement: Judging by that, it definitely wasn’t a reunion for Salcheonmun’s twelfth class.
findings.source: 보아하니 살천문 12기 동문회, 뭐 그런 목적이 아닌 건 확실하다.

findings.current: not to level up even after killing an enemy a full 140 levels high
findings.defect: “140 levels high” suggests a 140-level difference rather than an enemy whose Level is 140.
findings.rationale: 140레벨의 적 identifies the enemy’s Level, not the gap between the enemy and Jin.
findings.replacement: not to level up even after killing a Level 140 enemy
findings.source: 무려 140레벨의 적을 죽여도 레벨이 오르지 않을 정도로
